repository.description: Real-time collaborative canvas and whiteboarding platform with infinite zoom

overview.summary: WebGL-based collaborative canvas supporting 500+ concurrent users per session. Features real-time synchronization, infinite canvas, and advanced drawing tools with sub-100ms latency.

p1_risks.title: WebSocket frame validation
p1_risks.description: Insufficient validation of incoming canvas operations

p2_risks.title: Rate limiting on canvas operations
p2_risks.description: No per-user rate limiting for drawing operations

recommendations.title: Optimize rendering performance
recommendations.description: Frame rate drops below 30fps with 200+ objects

recommendations.title: Implement compression for sync packets
recommendations.description: Average packet size is 2.4KB, compressible to 400B
